body:
1. right now in the memory folder, we just assume to save one github project (so the it contains a flat github folder with issues discussions etc) and when quoting it in the memory notes, it will just use a simple id to quote. 
2. consider a case when other repos wants to duplicate and copy all the branches -- how can this be properly addressed? 

Proposal: 
1. folder structure: github/org/repo/issue-1.json 
2. use backlink style in the note `[[github/org/repo/issue-1.json]]`. 

@sepo-agent /answer

comments.body:
I agree with the proposed direction. The current layout is intentionally flat, so copying `agent/memory` across repos can mix old repo artifacts with new repo artifacts. Namespacing GitHub mirrors by repo solves that cleanly:

`github/<owner>/<repo>/<type>-<number>.json`

Example note reference:

```md
[[github/self-evolving/repo/issue-238.json]]
```

**Current state**

- Artifact path helpers hard-code the flat layout in [`memory-artifacts.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/memory-artifacts.ts#L71-L84).
- The sync CLI writes issues, PRs, and discussions through those helpers in [`sync-github-artifacts.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/memory/sync-github-artifacts.ts#L475-L500).
- Agent memory instructions still tell agents to read `github/*.json` and direct-link `github/issue-<n>.json` in [`_memory.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/_memory.md#L9-L16).
- Docs describe the flat mirror in [`memory.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/architecture/memory.md#L14-L27).
- Tests currently assert the flat paths in [`memory-artifacts.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/memory-artifacts.test.ts#L42-L45).

**Recommended implementation**

1. Change the artifact helpers to be repo-aware:
   - `issueArtifactPath(rootDir, repoSlug, number)` -> `github/<owner>/<repo>/issue-<n>.json`
   - same for PRs and discussions.
   - Keep paths relative to the memory root so backlink notes can quote the same string.

2. Update `sync-github-artifacts.js` to pass the current `args.repo` into the path helpers. This makes a copied memory branch preserve old repo history while new syncs write into the new repo namespace.

3. Add a compatibility migration for existing flat mirrors:
   - On `ensureMemoryStructure(rootDir, repoSlug)`, create `github/<owner>/<repo>/`.
   - If flat files like `github/issue-123.json` exist, move them into `github/<current-owner>/<current-repo>/issue-123.json` when the destination does not already exist.
   - Avoid leaving duplicate flat files, because `memory/search.js` recursively searches the tree already and duplicate artifacts would pollute results.

4. Update the prompts and docs:
   - `_memory.md`, `memory-scan.md`, and `daily-summary.md` should refer to `github/<owner>/<repo>/*.json`.
   - Tell agents to cite mirrored artifacts using `[[github/<owner>/<repo>/<artifact>.json]]`.
   - I would treat `[[...]]` as an agent/human backlink convention, not rely on GitHub Markdown rendering to make it clickable.

5. Also guard the sync cursor state for copied repos:
   - `memory-sync-state` stores `repo_slug` today, but `read-sync-state` does not reject a state whose slug differs from the current repo.
   - If someone copies all refs, a new repo could inherit an old `last_sync_at`. The fix is to ignore/reset sync state when `state.repo_slug !== current repo`, or namespace the sync-state ref by repo.
   - This is adjacent but important for the exact branch-copy scenario.

6. Update tests:
   - Replace flat-path assertions with namespaced path assertions.
   - Add migration coverage from `github/issue-5.json` to `github/owner/repo/issue-5.json`.
   - Add sync-state mismatch coverage so copied state does not suppress initial sync for the new repo.
   - Add/update search tests to confirm nested `github/owner/repo/pull-209.json` still ranks correctly.

No clarification blockers from my side. Please approve this direction before I implement it.
